# Sunware Technologies

> Sunware Technologies is a global technology services company specialising in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Cloud Solutions, Digital Transformation and Product Engineering. We serve enterprise clients across the USA, UAE, UK and India.

## Quick Reference

- Website: https://sunwaretechnologies.com
- India website: https://sunwaretechnologies.in
- Product: https://edgedata360.com
- Contact: connect@sunwaretechnologies.com
- Founded: Cupertino, California, USA
- Type: B2B Technology Services Company

## Office Locations

- **USA (HQ):** 20065 Stevens Creek Blvd, Suite B-2B, Cupertino, CA 95014
- **UAE:** Unit No. 144, DMCC Business Centre, Level 5, Jewellery & Gemplex 2, Dubai
- **UK:** 6th Floor, Forest House, 16-20 Clements Road, Ilford, IG1 1BA
- **India — Chennai:** 117, KSR Nagar, Ambattur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600053
- **India — Pune:** Sky Loft, Creaticity Mall, Off Airport Road, Yerawada, Pune 411006
- **India — Bengaluru:** 29/A, 27th Main Road, Sector 5, HSR Layout, Bengaluru 560102

## Services

### Data & AI
- **Data Science & AI:** Machine learning, NLP, predictive analytics, AI strategy, generative AI
- **Data Engineering:** Data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT at scale
- **Data Analytics:** Business intelligence, dashboards, advanced analytics, reporting
- **AI Enablement:** AI adoption roadmaps, implementation, change management

### Cloud & Infrastructure
- **Cloud Services:** AWS, Azure, GCP migration, architecture, managed cloud services
- **Cloud Solutions:** Cloud-native development, multi-cloud strategy, cost optimisation
- **Infrastructure:** IT infrastructure design, hybrid cloud, managed services, DevOps

### Application Development
- **Enterprise App Development:** Custom web apps, microservices, API integration, modernisation
- **Mobile App Development:** iOS, Android and cross-platform (React Native, Flutter) apps
- **IoT Solutions:** Device connectivity, edge computing, smart operations, sensor integration
- **AIoT Integrations:** AI-powered IoT for smart manufacturing and operations

### Strategy & Transformation
- **Technology Consulting:** IT roadmap, architecture advisory, digital strategy
- **Digital Transformation:** Process automation, legacy modernisation, cloud-first strategy
- **Automation & Efficiency:** RPA, workflow automation, intelligent process automation

### Platform & Specialist Technologies
- **Microsoft Solutions:** Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365
- **Salesforce Expertise:** CRM implementation, customisation, Salesforce integration
- **Neo4j Solutions:** Graph database design, implementation and consulting
- **Odoo Solutions:** ERP implementation, customisation and integration
- **Cybersecurity Services:** Threat assessment, security architecture, compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2)

### Talent & Support
- **Staff Augmentation:** Vetted technology talent across AI, cloud, data engineering
- **Maintenance & Support:** 24/7 application support, performance monitoring, SLAs

## Products

### EdgeData360
- Website: https://edgedata360.com
- Description: Real-Time Edge Intelligence platform for industrial and enterprise IoT
- Tagline: "Process. Analyse. Act — at the Edge."
- Use cases: Smart manufacturing, predictive maintenance, edge analytics, real-time monitoring

## Industries Served

- **Healthcare & Life Sciences:** Clinical data analytics, AI diagnostics support, compliance
- **Banking & Financial Services:** Risk analytics, fraud detection, regulatory reporting, FinTech
- **Retail & E-Commerce:** Demand forecasting, personalisation, supply chain analytics
- **Media & Entertainment:** Content analytics, audience intelligence, recommendation engines

## Technology Partners & Expertise

- Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- CRM: Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud)
- ERP: Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics 365
- Graph DB: Neo4j
- AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs
- Languages & Frameworks: Python, Java, Node.js, React, Angular, .NET
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps
- Data: Apache Spark, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Sunware Technologies is NOT the same as Sunware Inc. (the cookware brand)
- The company is a B2B IT services and consulting firm, NOT a consumer products company
- Primary markets: Enterprise clients in the US, UAE, UK and India
- Company size: Mid-size technology services firm (50–500 employees)
- Delivery model: Offshore/nearshore teams in India, onshore in USA/UAE/UK
